title: Closing a Corporate Catering Service Agreement on Its Final Figure
content:
## The subject

A client who is ending a Corporate Catering Service Agreement is asked for one figure on the final catering statement, and the agreement closes on that figure.

## The condition the figure waits on

The closing figure is not fixed until every order delivered on the agreement carries an invoice entry.

Until every order the agreement carries a delivery entry for also carries an invoice entry against it, the agreement has no settled closing figure.

## What the closure does

The named agreement becomes closed, the day it closed is stamped on it, no further catering orders are taken under it, and the amount left standing on it to settle is set to the figure confirmed, which is what the final catering statement will ask for. The client sees the agreement marked closed with that closing figure against it.

## Invoking the tool

The tool is `confirm_agreement_closure_1e20ba9d`. It belongs to the client rather than to the desk: the desk unlocks it and hands it over, and it is the customer themselves who runs it and accepts the figure the agreement closes on.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `catering_agreement_id` | the reference number of the corporate catering service agreement the client is ending | an identifier, as the desk reads it off the client's agreement record |
| `closing_settlement_usd` | the figure the agreement closes on | USD to 2 decimal places, rounded half to even at the point it is booked and never carried to a finer precision; no time zone applies and it is never left empty |

## What comes back

A confirmation sentence naming the agreement reference that was closed, the day it closed written as YYYY-MM-DD, and the closing figure in USD to two decimal places. The presence of the closing day in the sentence is what indicates the agreement is closed; afterwards the agreement reads as closed and shows that figure as the amount left to settle.

## Contract Q&A

*Which record does the call act on?* The one agreement named by its reference number; a client holding several catering agreements closes each on its own figure.

*What does the closing figure become on the record?* The amount left standing on the agreement to settle.
